description: Locus diagram of the VAM10/VPS5 antisense overprinting from retrieved NCBI coordinates, marking the VPS5 codons a vam10 ORF deletion would remove
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mp

# All coordinates below were retrieved from NCBI Gene esummary in the preceding cell.
VPS5  = dict(lo=453768, hi=455795, strand="+", aa=675)
VAM10 = dict(lo=453869, hi=454213, strand="-", aa=114)
ov0, ov1 = max(VPS5["lo"], VAM10["lo"]), min(VPS5["hi"], VAM10["hi"])

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 3.4))

# VPS5 on the forward strand
ax.add_patch(mp.FancyArrow(VPS5["lo"], 0.62, VPS5["hi"]-VPS5["lo"], 0, width=0.17,
                           head_width=0.17, head_length=90, length_includes_head=True,
                           facecolor="#4477aa", edgecolor="black", lw=0.8))
ax.text((VPS5["lo"]+VPS5["hi"])/2, 0.90, "VPS5 / YOR069W, 675 aa, forward strand",
        ha="center", fontsize=10)

# region of VPS5 removed by a yor068c ORF deletion
ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((ov0, 0.535), ov1-ov0, 0.17, facecolor="#cc6677",
                          edgecolor="none", alpha=0.85))
ax.text((ov0+ov1)/2, 0.62, "codons 34-149", ha="center", va="center",
        fontsize=8.5, color="white")

# VAM10 on the reverse strand
ax.add_patch(mp.FancyArrow(VAM10["hi"], 0.22, -(VAM10["hi"]-VAM10["lo"]), 0, width=0.17,
                           head_width=0.17, head_length=90, length_includes_head=True,
                           facecolor="#ddaa33", edgecolor="black", lw=0.8))
ax.text((VAM10["lo"]+VAM10["hi"])/2, -0.06,
        "VAM10 / YOR068C, 114 aa, reverse strand\n345 nt, 100 % inside VPS5",
        ha="center", va="top", fontsize=10)

ax.annotate("", xy=(ov0, 0.47), xytext=(ov0, 0.33),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", ls=":", color="grey"))
ax.annotate("", xy=(ov1, 0.47), xytext=(ov1, 0.33),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", ls=":", color="grey"))

ax.set_xlim(VPS5["lo"]-250, VPS5["hi"]+250)
ax.set_ylim(-0.45, 1.12)
ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("chromosome XV coordinate (S. cerevisiae S288C, NCBI Gene)")
ax.set_title("A deletion of the VAM10 ORF also removes 17 % of the VPS5 coding sequence",
             fontsize=11)
for s in ["left", "right", "top"]:
    ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print("overlap", ov0, ov1, ov1-ov0+1, "nt =", (ov1-ov0+1)//3, "VPS5 codons,",
      round(100*(ov1-ov0+1)/2028, 1), "% of the VPS5 CDS")
